net.heading: Net Income (Loss) per Share
net.text: The Company complies with accounting and disclosure requirements of FASB ASC 260, Earnings Per Share. In order to determine the net income (loss) attributable to both the redeemable shares and non-redeemable shares, the Company first considered the undistributed income (loss) allocable to both the redeemable shares and non-redeemable shares and the undistributed income (loss) is calculated using the total net loss less interest income and unrealized gain or loss on investments in trust account less any dividends paid. We then allocated the undistributed income (loss) ratably based on the weighted average number of shares outstanding between the redeemable and non-redeemable shares. Any remeasurement of the accretion to redemption value of the ordinary shares subject to possible redemption was considered to be dividends paid to the public shareholders.

wc.text: In order to fund working capital deficiencies or finance transaction costs in connection with an intended initial business combination, our Sponsor or an affiliate of our Sponsor or certain of our officers and directors may, but are not obligated to, loan us funds on a non-interest bearing basis as may be required. If we complete our initial business combination, we would repay such loaned amounts. In the event that our initial business combination does not close, we may use a portion of the working capital held outside the trust account to repay such loaned amounts but no proceeds from our trust account would be used for such repayment. Other than as described above, the terms of such loans by our officers and directors, if any, have not been determined and no written agreements exist with respect to such loans.

intro.text: AMC’s mission is to make the world a safer place through the use of high-quality, affordable and accessible vision AI technology. The Company currently sells smart hardware products designed for residential and commercial use, including smart cameras, driving recorders, action cameras and Retina K cameras. As of the date of this report, AMC’s operations are primarily focused on the sale of hardware products, and it does not currently provide integrated security products or subscription-based services directly to end users. In addition to its current product offerings, AMC is in the early stages of developing additional hardware products and technology capabilities, including IoT-enabled devices, AI-based features, wearable devices and AI robotics.

lines.name: Cash and cash equivalents
lines.why: Cash can repay debt or be paid out: a financial asset. Cash needed to run the business is operating; move it if you know how much.

lines.name: Receivables
lines.why: Owed by customers for sales: operating.

lines.name: Prepaid and other current assets
lines.why: Prepayments and other operating items: operating.

lines.name: Operating lease right-of-use assets
lines.why: Leased stores, offices and equipment used in the business: operating.

lines.name: Accounts payable
lines.why: Owed to suppliers for operations: operating.

lines.name: Other current liabilities
lines.why: Other operating items due within a year: operating.

lines.name: Operating lease liabilities
lines.why: Rent owed on leases used in the business: operating by default. Move it to financing to treat leases like debt (if the balance sheet has no lease line of its own, they sit inside other liabilities).

lines.name: Other current assets, not tagged separately
lines.why: Total current assets minus the current lines above: current assets the company tags its own way. Operating by default.

lines.name: Other non-current assets, not tagged separately
lines.why: Non-current assets (total assets − current assets) minus the non-current lines above: assets the company tags its own way. Operating by default.

lines.name: Other current liabilities, not tagged separately
lines.why: Total current liabilities minus the current lines above: current liabilities the company tags its own way. Operating by default.

lines.name: Other non-current liabilities, not tagged separately
lines.why: Non-current liabilities (total liabilities − current liabilities) minus the non-current lines above: liabilities the company tags its own way. Operating by default.

s.t: During the second quarter of 2026, the Company invested an aggregate of $1.0 million in Etronium AI Inc . through two Simple Agreements for Future Equity (“SAFEs”).
During the second quarter of 2026, the Company invested an aggregate of $1.0 million in Etronium AI Inc. through two Simple Agreements for Future Equity.
The cash used in investing activities during 2026 consisted primarily of the Company’s $1.0 million strategic investment in Etronium AI Inc. through two SAFEs.

The decrease primarily reflected approximately $1.5 million of net cash used in operating activities and the Company’s $1.0 million investment in Etronium AI Inc., partially offset by approximately $20,000 of proceeds from the exercise of warrants.

During the first six months of 2026, cash decreased primarily as a result of the Company’s $1.0 million strategic investment in Etronium AI Inc. and changes in working capital, partially offset by proceeds received from the exercise of warrants.
As of June 30, 2026, the carrying amount of the Company’s investment in Etronium AI Inc. was $ 1,000,000 .
